recentItems.title: Yung Pueblo | Journey: The Year That Changes Everything | Talks at Google
recentItems.description:
Diego Perez—the #1 New York Times bestselling author widely known by his pen name, Yung Pueblo—joined us to discuss his book, "Journey: The Year That Changes Everything: 365 Daily Reflections to Build Self-Awareness and Inner Peace." More than just a year-long guide to personal growth, it is a uniquely accessible and actionable journey filled with healing words and lasting wisdom.

Get the book here: https://goo.gle/3WfYRKw. 
Learn more about Yung Pueblo: https://yungpueblo.com/. 

Diego reminds us that growth is not a destination, but an inward journey to resolve two fundamental human struggles: letting go of stress and finding our purpose. Journey reveals that the answer to both lies in developing a deep state of inner balance.

Moderated by Mike Abrams.

recentItems.title: Broadway's The Lost Boys | Talks at Google
recentItems.description:
Ali Louis Bouzgui, Jennifer Duka and Miguel Gil from Broadway's The Lost Boys, the most Tony Award-winning new musical of the year, discuss the Broadway show based on the classic Warner Bros. film.
 
This electrifying production follows Michael, a teenager seeking a fresh start who falls in with a magnetic, rebellious rock band. They offer him the freedom and adventure he's been longing for—but as the band's dark, dangerous secret finally emerges, Michael must choose between his family and his desperate need to belong.

Learn more about the show: https://www.lostboysmusical.com/. 

Ali Louis Bourzgui (David) is a Tony Award winner for his role in The Lost Boys. His previous Broadway credits include starring as Tommy in The Who’s Tommy, for which he won the 2024 Theatre World and Jeff Awards, alongside OCC and Drama League nominations—and playing Orpheus in Hadestown. Off-Broadway, he received an OCC nomination for his work in We Live in Cairo, and he has also performed in the first national tours of Company (as Paul) and The Band’s Visit (as Haled). Outside of theater, Ali is one half of the band Resident Lightweight, whose debut concept album, Becomes a Home, is available across all streaming platforms. 

Jennifer Duka (Alan Frog) is thrilled to be making her Broadway debut. A proud Bay Area Filipina-American, she is a recent graduate of the NYU Tisch School of the Arts with a BFA in Drama. In 2022, she was notably nominated for the Irene Ryan Acting Scholarship at the Kennedy Center American College Theater Festival. Jennifer extends endless thanks to The Lost Boys creative team and the Telsey Office for helping her live her dream. 

Miguel Gil (Edgar Frog) returns to the Broadway stage following his run in the Original Broadway Cast and national tour of Kimberly Akimbo. His impressive regional credits include Bye Bye Birdie at the Kennedy Center, In the Heights at The Muny, and Follies at Carnegie Hall. A 2021 Jimmy Awards nominee, Miguel extends his heartfelt thanks to Mallory Tucker, Ben Carnegie, Shenandoah Conservatory, and the Telsey Office. 

Moderated by Suzanne Martin.

recentItems.title: R.L. Stine | Goosebumps & Beyond | Talks at Google
recentItems.description:
R.L. Stine, the mastermind behind the iconic "Goosebumps" series and one of the best-selling children's authors of all time, joins us to talk about the monsters that kept a generation awake at night to dive into his incredible creative journey, his prolific career, and his enduring cultural legacy. 

Check out R. L. Stine’s books: https://rlstine.com/bookshelf. 
Learn more about R. L. Stine: https://rlstine.com/. 

R.L. Stine is recognized as one of the best-selling children's authors in history, famously known for the Goosebumps series, which boasts over 400 million books in print. He has penned numerous other popular series, including "Fear Street," "Mostly Ghostly," and "The Nightmare Room," alongside recent publications for adults such as the comic collection "Stuff of Nightmares."

R. L. Stine's creations have seen massive success on screen. Notable adaptations include the hit Goosebumps TV series, the three-time Emmy-winning The Haunting Hour, the #1 Netflix Fear Street movie trilogy, and two Goosebumps feature films starring Jack Black.

In 2024, he was honored with a Grand Master lifetime achievement award from the Mystery Writers of America. 

Moderated by Prem Ramaswami.

recentItems.title: benny blanco | F*ck Failure | Talks at Google
recentItems.description:
Grammy Award–winning producer, artist, actor, and New York Times bestselling author, benny blanco, discusses his book, "F*ck Failure," which teaches you how to achieve your wildest dreams by seizing the most powerful opportunity you’ll ever be handed: failure.

Offering the "non-shortcut shortcuts" to success, this book will change how you view your setbacks. Soon enough, failure will start to feel good, and once you realize that failure is freedom, you’ll never look back.

Get the book here: https://goo.gle/3Vx3rn9.
Learn more about benny blanco: https://www.youtube.com/@bennyblanco.

benny blanco is a record producer, songwriter, artist, actor, and record executive who has contributed to the sale of hundreds of millions of albums worldwide. His work includes artists like Ed Sheeran, SZA, Justin Bieber, Rihanna, Katy Perry, The Weeknd, Maroon 5, Juice WRLD, Sia and many others. As a solo artist, his two albums—the Platinum Friends Keep Secrets and Gold Friends Keep Secrets 2—have amassed over 11 billion streams and feature multiple multi-platinum hits. Beyond music, benny made his TV debut playing a fictionalized version of himself on Dave (the #1 comedy on FX and FXX), and his debut cookbook, Open Wide, became an instant, multi-week New York Times bestseller. Most recently in 2026, he teamed up with his best friend Dave Burd (a.k.a. Lil Dicky) and Burd’s wife, Kristin Batalucco, to launch the multimedia podcast Friends Keep Secrets, featuring guests like Selena Gomez, Ed Sheeran and many more.

Moderated by Garrett Illing.

recentItems.title: Alexis Nikole Nelson | Happy Snacking, Don't Die! | Talks at Google
recentItems.description:
Beloved social media creator, vegan, urban forager, and outdoor educator Alexis Nikole Nelson—better known as Black Forager— discusses her New York Times bestselling book, "Happy Snacking, Don't Die!: Foraging and Vegan Recipes with Black Forager." In her guide to foraging and vegan cooking, she shows how you can find ingredients right in your own backyard.

The book provides a one-of-a-kind collection of recipes and foraging wisdom that teaches you how to turn common plants, flowers, and fungi into yummy, plant-based meals. With her signature humor and infectious spirit, Alexis proves that foraging isn’t just for survivalists—it’s for anyone who wants to connect with nature and add exciting new flavors to their table.

Get the book here: https://bit.ly/4xECYT9. 
Learn more about Alexis: https://www.youtube.com/c/BlackForager. 

With millions of followers online, Alexis’s foraging journey began at age five when her mother introduced her to onion grass. Today, she posts videos of her finds in a playful, humorous way—whether exploring a nearby park or searching in a neighbor’s front yard—proving that anyone can try their hand at foraging. Beyond showcasing her creative vegan cooking, her posts frequently address the indigenous roots of foraging in America, the history of American foraging laws, and sustainable ways for her viewers to include wild plants and mushrooms in their diets. Alexis has been featured in a broad range of media, from The New York Times to Jimmy Kimmel Live!, and was named a Time100 Creator in 2025.

Moderated by Chris Chestnut.

recentItems.title: Cheryl Strauss Einhorn | The Human Edge: Smarter Decisions in the Age of AI | Talks at Google
recentItems.description:
Award-winning author, educator, and Decisive CEO Cheryl Strauss Einhorn discusses her book, "The Human Edge: Smarter Decisions in the Age of AI," where she shares how you and your organization can confidently leverage AI for smart decision-making.

The Human Edge is an approachable guide for professionals and teams looking to make better choices with AI systems. It offers practical tools to frame problems and surface solutions—teaching you how to use AI to augment, not replace, your human judgment, curiosity, and values.

Get the book here: https://goo.gle/4w4LSHD. 
Learn more about Cheryl: https://areamethod.com/about-cheryl-einhorn/. 

Cheryl Strauss Einhorn is an adjunct professor at Cornell University, the founder of the decision-sciences company Decisive, and the creator of the AREA Method—a system designed to help individuals and organizations solve complex problems. She is also an award-winning author whose work explores the psychology of personal, professional, and financial decision-making. Her books include "Problem Solved," "Investing in Financial Research," and "Problem Solver" (with its companion, "Problem Solver Profiles"). 

Moderated by Marian Croak.

recentItems.title: Olajuwon Ajanaku | Eastside Golf | Talks at Google
recentItems.description:
Professional golfer, entrepreneur, and the founder and creative director of Eastside Golf, Olajuwom Ajanaku discusses his journey and how he disrupted the traditional golf industry. What began as a strategy to fund his own professional golf career evolved into a highly scalable business model by blending lifestyle aesthetics with the sport.

By successfully integrating culture and commerce, Eastside Golf achieved major milestones, including a landmark joint venture with Jordan Brand, a Hulu docuseries, and national campaigns with Sprite and Charles Schwab. Ultimately, the innovative approach bypassed traditional marketing by earning the authentic support of global sports icons like Michael Jordan and Chris Paul, elevating Eastside Golf from an apparel brand into a larger cultural movement.

Learn more about Olajuwon: https://olajuwonajanaku.com/. 
Learn more about Eastside Golf: https://eastsidegolf.com/.

Olajuwon is a professional golfer and the founder of Eastside Golf, a lifestyle apparel brand aiming to make the sport more inclusive and culturally connected. A native of East Atlanta, he played on a scholarship at Morehouse College, where he helped lead the golf team to a National Championship in 2010. After facing financial barriers in his early professional golf career and transitioning into commercial finance, he launched Eastside Golf in 2019 from his one-bedroom apartment.

Under his leadership, Eastside Golf has grown into an influential brand, partnering with major companies like Nike and Jordan Brand, for which Ajanaku has creatively directed numerous shoe collaborations. Beyond his business success, he is deeply dedicated to his community; he has helped raise over $600,000 for the Morehouse College golf team and introduced more than 1,100 new players to the game. His work has earned him widespread national recognition, including an opportunity to speak at the White House in 2024, all while he continues to compete professionally and lead his brand's global expansion.

Moderated by Richard Mordecai.

recentItems.title: Ethan Kross | Chatter | Talks at Google
recentItems.description:
One of the world’s leading experts on the science of emotion regulation, Dr. Ethan Kross, discusses his workbook "Chatter The Workbook: How to Stop Overthinking and Harness the Voice in Your Head," a companion to his acclaimed book "Chatter," which offers tools for understanding and harnessing the voice in your head.

In his nationally bestselling book, "Chatter," Dr. Kross explores the hidden power of our inner voice. This companion workbook delves even deeper, offering writing prompts, checklists, visual guides, and thought exercises designed to help you harness your chatter. By organizing practical self-care techniques into clear, actionable categories, he provides the ultimate toolkit for anyone looking to break free from endless cycles of negative self-talk, rumination, and worry.

Get the workbook here: https://goo.gle/4xau7aS. 
Get the book here: https://goo.gle/4fHRly9. 
Learn more about Ethan: https://www.ethankross.com/. 

Ethan Kross is an award-winning professor at the University of Michigan and the Ross School of Business, he also serves as the Co-Founder and Executive Director of the University of Michigan’s Institute for Mental Fitness—a first-of-its-kind moonshot effort to enhance emotional well-being on a global scale. He is the international bestselling author of Chatter and Shift, which have been translated into over 40 languages.

Ethan’s work bridges the gap between frontier science and practical application. He advises top executives, Fortune 100 organizations, and professional sports teams. His research is regularly featured in The New York Times and The New Yorker, as well as many of the world’s most rigorous scientific journals like Science and The New England Journal of Medicine. With over 8 million views across his TED and Big Think talks, Ethan’s insights have transformed how millions of people manage their emotions. He holds a PhD from Columbia University and a BA from the University of Pennsylvania.

Moderated by Chirag Nijjer.

recentItems.title: Rachel Glennerster | Innovation and the Center for Global Development | Talks at Google
recentItems.description:
President of the Center for Global Development,  Dr. Rachel Glennerster, discusses the CGD and why the future of global progress depends on simple, scalable, and evidence-based solutions. 

Discover how targeted innovations in health, education, agriculture, and social protection can overcome the deepest constraints in the world's emerging economies.

Learn more about the Center for Global Development: https://www.cgdev.org/. 

Prior to joining the Center for Global Development, Dr. Rachel Glennerster was at the University of Chicago. She has leveraged randomized trials to address critical issues spanning democracy, health, education, and women's empowerment and pioneered ways to shape markets to promote innovation to address global challenges including pandemics and climate change. 

Dr. Glennerster previously served as Chief Economist at the Foreign Commonwealth & Development Office (FCDO) and the Department for International Development in the UK. From 2004 to 2017, she served as Executive Director of the Abdul Latif Jameel Poverty Action Lab (J-PAL), a center in the Economics Department at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology which seeks to reduce poverty by ensuring policy is informed by scientific evidence and helped pioneer the use of randomized trials in development economics.

In 2021, Dr. Glennerster was appointed Companion of the Order of St. Michael and St. George (CMG) for services in international development. She also currently serves as the Chair of Teaching at the Right Level Africa (TaRL Africa).

recentItems.title: Rebecca Winthrop | Rethinking the Purpose of Education in the Age of AI | Talks at Google
recentItems.description:
Leading global authority on education, Brookings scholar and an adjunct professor at Georgetown University Rebecca Winthrop discusses the intersection of AI and technology in learning through a balanced and deeply considered lens. 

As an expert on the fundamental purpose of education, she speaks with conviction about the need to move learners into "explorer mode." Rebecca, who leads cutting-edge research to transform global education systems, offers an inspiring roadmap for ensuring technology serves as a bridge to success, empowering every child to thrive in work, life, and as an engaged citizen in an increasingly digital world.

Learn more about Rebecca:  https://www.linkedin.com/in/rebecca-winthrop-b36b0617/. 

Rebecca Winthrop is the director of the Center for Universal Education. She is dedicated to ensuring that every child has the opportunity to thrive in life, work, and as an engaged citizen. She leads cutting-edge research and initiatives aimed at transforming education systems around the world to better support children's learning and development. 

Rebecca is a trusted advisor to both school communities and national and international organizations. Her expertise is sought by many including parent networks, schools, district education leaders, the White House, the United Nations, and Fortune 500 companies. Rebecca's work is centered on developing and advocating for evidence-based strategies that bring people together—families, educators, policymakers, and companies—to help children maximize their potential. 

She holds a PhD from Columbia University’s Teachers College, an MA from its School of International and Public Affairs, and a BA from Swarthmore College.

Moderated by Benedict Gomes.

recentItems.title: Dr. Robert Wachter | A Giant Leap: How AI Is Transforming Healthcare... | Talks at Google
recentItems.description:
Physician and thought leader Dr. Robert Wachter discusses his book "A Giant Leap: How AI Is Transforming Healthcare and What That Means for Our Future," an engaging, clear-eyed, and ultimately hopeful examination of healthcare’s efforts to embrace generative artificial intelligence.

Dr. Wachter shares an indispensable roadmap for healthcare leaders, clinicians, and patients. It is a vibrant and timely account of how AI is changing what it means to care—and be cared for—in this age of astonishing technology.

Get the book here: https://goo.gle/3RdrMwo. 

Robert Wachter is Professor and Chair of the Department of Medicine at the University of California, San Francisco (UCSF). He has appeared on Modern Healthcare magazine’s list of the 50 most influential physician-executives in the US more than a dozen times; he was #1 on the list in 2015. An elected member of the National Academy of Medicine, he coined the term “hospitalist” and is considered the father of the hospitalist field, the fastest-growing specialty in the history of medicine. He is the author of five books, including the New York Times bestseller The Digital Doctor.

Moderated by Michael Howell, Chief Health Officer.

recentItems.title: Leo Ku  | From Passion to Profession | Talks at Google
recentItems.description:
HKG, singer, actor, model, MV director, producer and designer, Leo Ku, shares his stories around how he’s been able to turn his passion into a remarkable career, how he has overcome the challenges faced along the way, and how he's using his influence to discover and mentor the next generation of aspiring local artists.

Learn more about Leo: https://www.youtube.com/@leoku8437. 

Leo Ku is a multifaceted artist who has made a significant impact on Hong Kong's entertainment industry since his debut in 1991. Launching his music career in 1994, he has become one of Cantopop's most decorated artists, releasing over 35 albums and garnering more than 350 music awards.

His critical acclaim reached a new height in 2004 at the “Ultimate Song Chart Awards Presentation,” where he won the “Ultimate Male Singer Gold Award,” “My Most Favourite Male Singer,” and “My Most Favourite Song Award”—a rare achievement previously accomplished only by Leon Lai. His success continued with four consecutive “Most Popular Male Singer” titles at the “Jade Solid Gold Best Ten Music Awards Presentation” from 2008 to 2011. He has also won the “Hit Male Singer” title seven times and the prestigious “4 Stations Joint Music Awards – Song Award” three times (2005, 2006, 2009), solidifying his prominent status in the Hong Kong music scene.

In addition to music, Leo achieved widespread fame as an actor. In 2000, his lead role as He Shuhuan in the TV drama “Romance in the Rain” catapulted him to stardom across China, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Singapore, and Malaysia. The series' immense success made it one of the most replayed dramas in China for several years.

Beyond his career as a singer and actor, Leo is also a creator and entrepreneur. He designed his own comic character, “Kubi,” becoming a pioneering Hong Kong artist by publishing his own comic books. His business ventures include the bakery “Alice Wild-Luscious” and two fashion brands, “SOLO CELEB” and “HTDG.” In recognition of his professional achievements and contributions to society, Leo was honored as one of the “Ten Outstanding Young Persons of Hong Kong” in 2005.

Moderated by James Tao.
